## Cameras with Real-Time AI Analysis

Our engineers train the AI model to analyze the visual data and help you solve almost any problem.

![Station Camera](https://www.sitevue.ai/station-camera.jpg)

Station Camera

Our station cameras are fixed to line equipment or overhead structures for line-level visibility. Powered and connected to the internet for real-time data capture across every line and production zone.

![SiteVue hard hat camera giving a first-person view of an operator's work](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/699f61a6ef80db724a0c588c/b08c86cd-88a4-4e97-82ea-c0e382e2966c/IMG_2962.jpg)

Hard Hat Camera

First-person POV mounted directly on the operator's hard hat. Captures exactly what each team member sees, ideal for line setup verification, gauge checks, and quality control inspections.

![SiteVue uniform-clipped wearable camera on a production operator](https://www.sitevue.ai/uniform-camera-bg-treated.jpg)

Uniform Camera

Clipped to the operator's uniform for hands-free, wearable capture. Easy to deploy across large teams with no equipment modifications or plant infrastructure changes required.

![SiteVue camera built into standard PPE safety glasses for hands-free first-person capture](https://www.sitevue.ai/safety-glasses-camera.jpg)

Safety Glasses Camera

Built into standard PPE safety glasses for a true first-person view with zero added gear. Lightweight and unobtrusive, ideal for operators who need hands-free capture.

FAQs

## Common Questions

### How long does setup take?

SiteVue installs in days, with no software integration required, and runs independently of your IT systems.

### Is there any hardware or software integration required?

No. SiteVue provides all hardware and software: it's included in your monthly subscription. We only need to connect our hardware to one internet location.

### Is SiteVue easy to use?

Yes. Managers are trained on the SiteVue dashboard in under an hour.

### What types of cameras does SiteVue offer?

SiteVue offers Station Cams, Hard Hat Cams, Uniform Cams, and Safety Glasses Cams with real-time AI analysis. Customers can mix and match cameras based upon their needs.

### Is SiteVue scalable?

Yes. SiteVue scales to any size team.

### Is there a setup fee?

Yes. A one-time setup fee is charged per camera.

### How does SiteVue charge?

SiteVue charges a monthly subscription fee per camera, which includes equipment cost and AI model training. Annual billing is also available. Customers can cancel anytime.

### Is worker footage kept private?

Yes. No audio is captured, and video is processed in a closed system, independent of your IT infrastructure. Worker footage is used for operational metrics only and can be blurred out.

### Can the hardware handle a manufacturing floor environment?

Yes. SiteVue cameras are built for plant floors. During the site visit, our team confirms the right camera and mounting for each area.
